# Outcome-first companion responses

The financial consequence is the main response, not a second summary beneath a
long answer. Finney generates one or two short sentences first, including any
material unpaid status, uncertainty, failure or required decision. If explanation
helps, it follows the exact blank-line delimiter `Details:` inside the existing
stored explanation/message string. No new JSON field, migration, financial
permission or promotion rule is introduced.

The UI only collapses an explicitly marked supplementary section. It never takes
the first sentence/paragraph of an old response and silently hides the remainder.
Unmarked historic replies, recorded failures and exact stored outputs remain
intact. Structured blockers and clarification remain visible; the generator is
instructed that Details must never be the only place for a material caveat.
Concision is generation guidance, not a hard sentence limit or a claim that a
text parser can verify the financial truth of a model response.

Changes and duplicate handling may be described only when observed prior/current
records and actual successful operations support them. No demo amounts or deltas
are manufactured by the UI. The current case result leads; supporting documents
remain accessible through an expansion after a result. Before a review, documents
remain available in the existing work view.

This protected prompt change invalidates earlier learning preflight bindings.
No learned improvement or new final-holdout result is attributed to the change.

## Verification

Backend contract/persistence tests and browser interaction checks are recorded
with the hosted invoice/reimbursement results after execution. Fixture rendering
is not evidence of model compliance; live replies are retained verbatim.

Actual hosted Sonnet 5.5 verification used the normal queued review path:

- Invoice: seven provider calls; 29-word, two-sentence primary answer. Readback
  confirms the same obligation changed from USD 480 to USD 420, with zero settled.
  The supplementary explanation retains a recovered first mutation error; neither
  the original trace nor failure is rewritten.
- Reimbursement: seven calls; one USD 87 obligation recorded from the receipt
  packet, with no prior matching obligation, no approval and no payment. Its first
  primary answer was 52 words/three sentences, including unnecessary future
  payment-routing setup. That reply is preserved.
- After clarifying relevance to the current operation, a real read-only follow-up
  took two calls and produced a 46-word main answer: USD 87 owed, no reimbursement
  recorded, and the organizer's report is not independently confirmed. Financial
  records were unchanged. It still used three sentences; the one-to-two-sentence
  target is not guaranteed, and no text was clipped to manufacture compliance.

The prompt correction leaves structured future payment requirements intact.
All live checks used a disclosed fictional practice event with real inference and
hosted persistence; they do not demonstrate real-world payment or reimbursement.

Local verification: 26 backend contract/persistence tests passed, with 14 relevant
checks re-run after the stage-relevance wording correction. The UI passed 31 unit
checks, production build/TypeScript and 18 desktop/mobile browser checks. Two
initial companion fixture failures came from checking Details before delivering
the fixture reply; the test sequencing/escaping was corrected and both passed.
The initial failure captures are retained privately. Hosted rendering acceptance
follows deployment and is recorded separately from those fixture checks.
